authorship: User-directed Supervisor repair; independent AI source and boundary review, not autonomous researcher evolution

smallness.reason: One standalone evidence-reader boundary combines exact policy admission, descriptor-relative no-symlink reads, shared limits, durable prepared-response audit and local stdio framing. Mechanically splitting at 200 lines would add interfaces without reducing authority or causal blast radius. No second production module, consumer integration, data permission, evaluator or budget rule changed. Acceptance applies only to this reviewed 284-line snapshot.

independent_verification.scope: Synthetic fixtures and local broker protocol subprocess only; imported inherited unittest classes can repeat, so this is not a claim of 172 unique tests.
independent_verification.tracked_python_method: Independently recomputed SHA256 of sorted compact JSON mapping git-ls-files research/market_rsi Python paths to file SHA256 before new files were staged.
independent_verification.protected_source_diff_against_head: No changes in experiments, account consumer, worker, batch recorder or learning assessment.

boundary_checks: Approved identifiers and exact policy/source hashes gate returned evidence; tool calls cannot supply filesystem paths.

Descriptor-relative directory traversal and final open use O_NOFOLLOW; source bytes are read from the pinned descriptor and hashed before any text is returned, avoiding a hash-then-reopen disclosure race.
Unlisted IDs, model-supplied paths, symlink parents/leaves, traversal, FIFO/nonregular sources, oversized files and invalid UTF-8 are denied with no evidence text returned.
Exhausted calls and exactly consumed output budget are rejected before subsequent reads; serialized tool-payload accounting includes successful and denied tool values.

One process lock serializes concurrent calls. Atomic exclusive creation of the same approved audit path rejects another instance or silent same-policy restart; no cross-policy shared global-budget service is claimed.

Prepared responses are durably audited before broker return; fsync failure, zero write or replaced audit inode poisons the session and emits no result. Receipts explicitly do not confirm consumer delivery.

Strict JSON rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite constants and overflowing float literals. Invalid JSON-RPC IDs are normalized to null before tool dispatch; oversized/incomplete frames stop without executing a trailing request.

Local newline JSON-RPC subprocess roundtrip passes without a model session. Production imports are exclusively argparse, hashlib, json, math, os, re, stat, sys and threading; no E2B, Tinker, provider, network or hidden training path exists.

resolved_preliminary_findings.original_observation: In-memory NaN-ID request invoked Probe.call and then failed response serialization.
resolved_preliminary_findings.resolution: Strict parsing and legal ID validation prevent dispatch; explicit regression also covers numeric overflow, container/boolean IDs and duplicate keys.

resolved_preliminary_findings.original_observation: Output exhaustion could be discovered only after another evidence read.
resolved_preliminary_findings.resolution: Exact exhaustion is checked before policy or source reads and verified by a zero-reader-call regression.

existing_policy_correction.remaining_restrictions_not_changed: Bounded follow-up is exactly one; zero/duplicate-credit forecasts cannot continue/branch; parents must be ranked eligible evidence; consumed C2 remains excluded. These are future policy decisions, not missing sidecar features.
